description: Appendix E 提供 L2 ridge 作为 regularization control，识别 under-sampled 非平凡风险缺失；这是基线对照，不是组件删除。

name: latent_space_choice
description: LM text, CLIP text, and LDM latent are compared on NSD in Table 4 and on BOLD5000/GOD in Table 7.

name: object_centric_diffusion_removal
description: w/o ObjC. replaces object-level cross-attention with standard U-Net cross-attention and degrades the three reported metrics.

name: prompt_optimization_best_worst
description: w/o AttOpt.+Bst and w/o AttOpt.+Wst fix the best or worst initial keyword and both underperform full search.

name: object_count
description: One, two, and four object slots are compared; two is reported best, while four can omit objects during denoising.

name: spatial_seed_exclusion
description: Appendix J removes spatial-related initial keywords and tracks whether spatial terms reappear.

name: attribute_binding_failure
description: Appendix A gives a gray tiger-striped cat to gray tiger failure as the negative motivation for object-centric generation.

name: HiAgent framework substitution
description: Replace ReAct with HiAgent for GPT-4.1 on QT4-F; QT4-1 falls 50→40%, QT4-2 rises 46→52%, QT4-3 rises 34→40%.

name: QT4 self-review
description: Five-minute callbacks permit workflow/state inspection and cancellation without explicit success/failure notification; recovery is 8.0%, 18.5%, 0.0%.

name: QT2 clarification multi-turn
description: GPT-4.1 plus GPT-4.1-mini user simulator and ask_user raises QT2-F from 44% to 50%; ask_user appears in 10/28 failed cases.

name: QT2 correction-loop multi-turn
description: Explicit “Incorrect. Please review and try again” feedback raises QT2-F from 44% to 54%, with high residual failure.

name: Post-execution oracle failure notice
description: GPT-5 mini user simulator explicitly reports failed scheduled state; recovery reaches 60.0%, 55.6%, 66.7%, marked unrealistic upper bound.

name: Supervised fine-tuning
description: Gemma3-4B-it and Qwen3-32B train on 204 GPT-5.1 gold trajectories; gains concentrate in infeasible detection and do not solve QT4-3-F.

name: GPT-4.1 QT2-F transition sensitivity
description: Immediate evaluation gives 44%; allowing a 3-second brightness-transition delay gives 62%, exposing an implementation/timing confound.

name: Binary RPE removal
description: Table 1 将 Binary with RPE 与 Binary without RPE 并列；识别 RPE 对 binary length generalization 的作用，但两个模型规模不匹配。

name: Unary/NoPE versus Binary/RPE regime contrast
description: 跨表示方式的理论条件对照，测试 NoPE unary 与 RPE binary 是否分别符合预测；不是单一组件删除。

name: component deletion, hyperparameter sensitivity, heterogeneity and robustness
description: 没有独立组件逐项删除、规模/超参曲线、任务异质性分解、failure-case analysis 或 robustness table。

name: Chess branch width k
description: k=1/2/3 functions as breadth sensitivity: accuracy 31.3→54.7%, time saved 11.8→19.5%.

name: E-commerce model ensemble and budget
description: Single versus multi-model and low/medium/high reasoning budgets; multi-model bars are consistently higher.

name: HotpotQA top-k
description: Top-1 versus top-3 exact API matching for three Speculators.

name: OS role ablation
description: Actor-only, Speculator-only and joint systems separate slow deliberation, fast reaction and complementary roles.

name: Selective confidence threshold
description: A simple >50% threshold is compared with naively launching 1/2/3 branches; it operationalizes Theorem 3 only approximately.

name: Depth versus breadth
description: Theorem 6 supplies an analytic alternative, but there is no depth-focused empirical arm.

name: Dedicated ablation section
description: No heading named Ablation; sensitivity and role comparisons are distributed through Sections 3–5.

name: Irreversible-side-effect failure cases
description: The paper warns about delete/order effects but supplies no rejected-branch trace or correctness audit for them.

name: error_term_Eimg_Evid_Enoi
description: Table 4 以 1-epoch tuning 删除各 error：Eimg removal 的四项均明显下降；Evid/Enoi 为相对辅助收益。full SVI 为 94.69/95.39/61.88/71.22，w/o Eimg 为 73.82/84.21/49.58/57.63。

name: naive_metric_fooling
description: Copy Clips、Ping-Pong Clips、Copy Reference Img 将 consistency/quality 推至约 98–100%，但 Dynamic Degree 变为 0–7.14%，显示单一指标可被复制策略欺骗。

name: online_error_injection
description: Offline=93.52/95.86/58.07/62.81；single-pass=94.65/95.65/58.66/64.85；two-pass=94.96/95.89/59.31/65.24；online 多数 quality/consistency 略升但 Dynamic Degree 降低。

name: vbench_external_evaluation
description: Table 11 用 50 cases、50-clip length 复核 SVI 与 Wan/HistoryGuidance/FramePack，作为标准 benchmark 的附加检查。

name: deterministic versus stochastic posterior
description: Table 2 includes w/Deterministic and SFA rows; deterministic is better for within-distribution NMI/ARI while stochastic is better for OOD NMI/ARI.

name: Gaussian/parametric versus CNF posterior
description: CNF-posterior row and runtime paragraph isolate expressiveness/compute cost, but do not hold all training details visible.

name: posterior-family complexity recommendation
description: Authors recommend smaller/simple parametric Q for low-dimensional or multi-component settings based on stability and runtime observations.

name: time-dependent versus constant-time Gumbel-Softmax
description: Both choices are described but no controlled numerical comparison is supplied.

name: CNF likelihood component deletion
description: No same-capacity controlled replacement/removal ablation of conditional CNF likelihood is reported.

name: latent dimension/network-size sweep
description: No latent-dimension, MLP-size, decoder-depth or FiLM sensitivity curve is provided.

name: seed/replicate robustness
description: No per-seed result table, interval, or failure count is reported.

name: compute scaling
description: CNF posterior timing and 5000-dimensional likelihood omission reveal compute boundaries, but no dimension or dataset-size scaling curve exists.

name: equal factor weighting vs learned weighting
description: LOOCV across four domains uses linear regression to maximize MOS correlation; Simple Mean wins three held-out domains and loses on Kids.

name: learned coefficient stability
description: Coefficients change by training domain and can become negative: Generic −0.162 on Clean, Generic −0.017/Intelligibility −0.020 on Wild, Prosody −0.032 on Kids.

name: factor-by-domain correlation
description: Appendix Table 8 reports Pearson r for four factors, identifying Speaker strength on Clean/Noisy and Generic/Intelligibility complementarity on Wild/Kids.

name: pre-correlation feature screening
description: Ground-truth halves are compared before human-correlation experiments; candidates below average 95 or with high cross-dataset standard deviation are excluded.

name: component deletion and sample-size sensitivity
description: 没有逐项移除 factor、恢复 Environment、替换 noise anchor、改变 50–100 samples 或报告 feature/sample-size sensitivity 的独立结果。

name: filtering and contamination sensitivity
description: 没有对 XNLI/Pyannote/Demucs thresholds、跨语言误筛率、训练语料 contamination 或 pipeline rerun stability 的消融。

name: GReaT-sort column order
description: Only finetuning column order changes; GT topological order improves global utility on every core SCM.

name: Predictor ensemble pruning
description: Full/Light/Tiny tuned/default configurations test predictor-count and tuning sensitivity; global rankings are stable while local rankings fluctuate.

name: Absolute versus relative utility
description: Changing normalization changes correlation with global CI from 0.57 to 0.84.

name: Continuous versus discrete variants
description: Alternative CI and utility outcome definitions remain mutually correlated at 0.80–0.86.

name: Synthetic sample size ratio
description: Fixing reference size and varying synthetic size shows saturation after Nsyn reaches Nref.

name: Data availability
description: Subsampling Nfull from 100 to 100,000 retains high global utility/global CI correlation.

name: Latent-confounder injection
description: Injecting 1–5 confounders and using MAG m-separation provides a limited proof-of-concept.

name: Independent-set split
description: Changing to Dtrain:Dtest:Dindep:Dvalid=3:3:3:1 reveals overfit/privacy and training-size sensitivity patterns.

name: Causal-inference check
description: Interventional and counterfactual MSE provide an external task correspondence for the structural proxy.

name: rank_ablation
description: Figure 2 changes rank for LoRA-Pre Adam/Muon and GaLore on 60M/130M to identify rank efficiency under memory budgets.

name: rank_training_trajectory
description: Figure 3 changes LoRA-Pre Muon rank on 130M and tests whether early gaps diminish during training.

name: muon_optimizer_transfer
description: Table 3 adapts GaLore and Fira to Muon and compares them with Muon and Muon without momentum.

name: beta_gamma_sensitivity
description: Appendix D varies β1/β2 around defaults and derives γ coupling; β near one causes divergence.

name: random_contrastive_pair
description: Replacing the immediately previous token with a uniformly sampled earlier token (r<25) changes the metric difference by FVE 0.00, Fraction Alive −0.05, high Smoothness 0.00, semantics −0.02, context +0.11, syntax −0.10; longer context helps contextual probing while hurting syntax.

name: feature_split_50_50
description: Increasing the high/low split to 50:50 gives differences FVE −0.01, Fraction Alive +0.01, high Smoothness 0.00, semantics +0.02, context +0.09, syntax −0.08.

name: feature_split_10_90
description: Reducing high-level capacity to 10:90 gives differences FVE 0.00, Fraction Alive −0.07, high Smoothness −0.02, semantics −0.01, context +0.01, syntax +0.01.

name: naive_temporal_similarity
description: The no-contrastive variant uses sample-wise ℓ_i=α||z_t^(i)−z_{t−1}^(i)||². It gives FVE +0.01, Fraction Alive +0.06, high Smoothness +0.07, semantics −0.07, context −0.10, syntax +0.01, showing weaker semantic/context structure despite slightly better reconstruction metrics.

name: MSE 选层
description: Wan+VGGT 扫描 stitching index；低 layer residual 对应更好的 pointmap，直接检验 Eq.(2) 的选层标准。

name: CKA 替代诊断
description: CKA 能跟踪总体随层深度退化，但不能识别最佳 layer 2；论文保留 MSE 作为更可靠 indicator。

name: direct reward 组件
description: Table 6 对 no-finetuning、multi-view-only、consistency-only、quality-only、full 逐项比较；consistency alone 使图像变 blur，quality 提升 prompt/美学，full 取得最佳 imaging/Unified Reward。

name: finetuning strategy qualitative
description: Fig.7 显示 no-finetuning 的动态 motion/ghosting，multi-view-only 抑制运动却丢 semantic detail，Ours 更 sharp。

name: integrated versus sequential
description: Eq.(7)/Fig.8 注入 controlled latent perturbation，直接 stitched decoder 比先 decode RGB 再原生 VGGT 更鲁棒。

name: cross-VAE layer analysis
description: Fig.10 扩展到 CogVideoX、SVD、Hunyuan、Wan 与 MVDUSt3R/AnySplat，显示单架构内的早层规律以及绝对 MSE 的跨架构失效。

name: iteration-count and exact SVD
description: GPT-2-Small Muon compares 2–30 Polar Express iterations and exact SVD; utility saturates at 5–6 while SVD doubles runtime.

name: finite-precision safety and cushioning
description: The safety factor and lower-ratio cushion prevent overflow and sign-changing non-monotone updates; stabilized curve has p_t(x)/x >= 0.236.

name: small singular-value treatment
description: Exact, truncated, and reverse Muon directly test whether low singular directions matter; differences are negligible below the reported cutoffs.

name: top-spectrum metric
description: Projection onto singular values above sigma_max/10^3 checks convergence in directions relevant to the optimization hypothesis.

name: weight decay
description: A weight-decay 0.1 rerun broadly reproduces the no-decay ordering.

name: number of training tokens
description: A selected subset is extended from 1B to 10B tokens; Polar Express retains a small consistent lead while the gap shrinks.

name: cross-task image classification
description: CIFAR/ResNet/ViT checks whether the Muon improvement transfers beyond GPT-2; the paper reports no consistent Polar Express advantage.

name: spectrum-aware initializer
description: A subspace/power-method lower bound and cubic interpolation target isolated large singular values; result is synthetic only.
evidence_sections: I Initialization for Matrices with Large Spectral Gaps

name: rectangular fast iteration and restart
description: Algorithm 3 tests aspect-ratio runtime and restart intervals; J.1 tests practical GPT-Small Muon integration.

name: TBQ, TBE, and hybrid component ablation
description: Table 4 separates accuracy, normalized throughput, and latency: TBQ 77.8 accuracy but 1.1× throughput; TBE 512 has 62.5 accuracy and 1.78× throughput; ThinKV has 76.4, 1.51×, and 0.42×.

name: Thought-adaptive versus token-level heuristic
description: Figure 10(a) uses recall of Top-10 attention-score tokens to compare ThinKV, R-KV, and LazyEviction.

name: Generation-length inflation
description: Figure 10(d) shows pure quantization can inflate generation length up to 5.1×; ThinKV is said to avoid this behavior.

name: Refresh-rate sensitivity
description: Figure 10(c) varies tau on GPT-OSS-20B LiveCodeBench; tau=128 is chosen as the accuracy-overhead trade-off.

name: Selected-layer and thought-type sensitivity
description: Figure 11(a) varies |L*|, |T|, and minR; |L*|=4 and |T|=3 are selected.

name: Minimum-retention failure case
description: Complete eviction minR=0 severely degrades accuracy and causes endless reasoning loops; minR=4 is retained.

name: Precision assignment
description: Figure 11(b) varies R/E/T precision and motivates R4E4T2.

name: Eviction and gather overhead
description: Table 5 contrasts ThinKV 4.59% TBE call rate with R-KV 82.93% eviction/gather call rate.

name: Block size and thought distribution
description: Figure 10(e) varies block size; Figure 10(f) shows thought-type mix by dataset.

name: Data-format ablation
description: Table 10 replaces NVFP4/ternary with INT4/INT2 and reports lower AIME and LiveCodeBench accuracy.

name: Quantization sensitivity by K/V and thought type
description: Figure 16 varies INT precision for one K or V thought type while fixing all others at 8-bit.

name: pair_construction
description: HQ-Edit/DOCCI/VisCoR comparison shows performance depends on construction data distribution; VisCoR covers broader reasoning tasks.

name: base_model_transfer
description: Qwen2.5VL-3B and InternVL2.5-8B both gain on Hallusion, MathVision and MMStar.

name: easy_sample_inclusion
description: Adding 20K or 40K easy samples lowers all three scores versus 0K; Hallusion is not monotonic between 20K and 40K.

name: positive_negative_counterparts
description: Positive-only, negative-only and combined GQA training sets identify negative pair advantage and combined Total optimum.

name: difficulty_filtering
description: The pipeline keeps only median samples; easy and hard samples are excluded before rationale generation.

name: threshold_sensitivity
description: No φq/φv sweep or alternative embedding comparison is reported.

name: postprocessing_ablation
description: No text-matching filter-off control or false-removal rate is reported.

name: FlashMLA staged component ablation
description: Starts with TL-Heuristic and progressively enables Tile, Alloc, and Partition relative to Triton.

name: H100 contribution
description: +Tile is 1.31×; building on it +Partition gives additional 4.34×.

name: MI300X contribution
description: +Alloc is 6.56×; combined with +Tile adds 1.75×.

name: scope and negative state
description: Only FlashMLA is called the representative example; Figure 9 marks some MI300X variants out of smem.

name: No-CoT direct answer
description: On 5-digit addition it reaches perfect in-distribution accuracy but little-to-no length generalization.

name: No-CoT reversed answer
description: Reversing the direct answer retains perfect five-digit accuracy without meaningful length generalization.

name: No Tool-Use trajectory
description: The model must predict tool outputs rather than receive observations; the appendix says this has poor in-distribution performance.

name: Single-Turn Tool-Use calculator
description: One addition command gives perfect five-digit accuracy but little-to-no length generalization.

name: Multiplication training steps and digit length
description: Figure 7 varies 250/500/800 steps and max train length 5/10/20. More digits and steps improve OOD stability; 20 digits is perfect through the 1,000-digit tested endpoint.

name: Task mixture
description: Addition auxiliary data gives minor benefit at 250 steps, a larger benefit for some weights at 500, and all settings converge under 800 steps. Figure 8–9 show seed-variability bars.

name: Hanoi algorithm and seed sensitivity
description: The recursive trajectory is weaker than iterative; exact accuracy is sensitive to seed although Mamba token accuracy can exceed 99.75% at 12 disks.

name: Hybrid-Mamba and RMT
description: Hybrid-Mamba retains the main addition behavior; RMT does not length-generalize despite in-distribution learning.

name: triplet component removal
description: No Triplet Loss reduces Math 80.7→79.0 and Code 33.0→31.0, with lower scores across all six dimensions.

name: Gaussian prior removal
description: No Gaussian Prior reduces Reliability 86.8→82.5 and lowers the other listed dimensions.

name: uniform/random weight controls
description: Uniform and Random Weight are below Full Method in all six columns; Random is close to base on some reasoning/code dimensions.

name: softmax prior control
description: Softmax Prior is below the Full Method; its temperature is not specified.

name: λ sensitivity
description: λ values 0, .1, .3, .5, .7, .9, 1.0 are tested on GSM8K and IFEval; intermediate values are relatively stable.

name: α sensitivity
description: α values .1, .2, .3, .5 are tested; Avg peaks at .3, while final settings list .5.

name: label-noise robustness
description: Four noise levels compare DPO/TPO/TI-DPO; TI-DPO retains the highest listed accuracy at each level.

name: generation diversity
description: Self-BLEU, Distinct-2/4 and Entropy favor TI-DPO in the reported aggregate.

name: convergence
description: Table B10 reports lower TI-DPO loss at every listed epoch.

name: gradient-attribution-only factorial ablation
description: Table 2 has controls/removals but no full factorial that isolates gradient attribution independently from Gaussian prior, and no matched attribution intervention.

name: negative/compute boundary
description: Appendix D records approximately 2× training time and lower MMLU/GPQA/GSM8K relative to sequence-level baselines.
evidence_sections: D.1 Computational Overhead|D.2 Performance Analysis on Reasoning-Heavy Benchmarks

name: direct 5-shot 对照
description: 5-shot direct 的 τ=0.61，高于 0-shot 但低于 TBT=0.76；它比较 task preparation 强度，不是组件删除。

name: 大测试集 robustness
description: 只保留 10 个 test samples>2,000 的 benchmark，τ 0.51/0.63/0.80，主方向不变。
evidence_sections: B.5 Impact of Test Set Size

name: 模型尺寸分层
description: 每个 size bin 至少 5 个模型；每个 bin 的 TBT agreement 高于 direct，但总体值因移除 compute variation 而降低。
evidence_sections: B.6 Ranking Agreement for Models of the Same Size

name: 模型家族分层
description: 各 family 至少 5 个模型；四个 family 的 TBT PC1>89%，Yi 的 TBT agreement 为 0.30。
evidence_sections: B.7 Ranking Agreement for Models of the Same Family

name: 统计口径 τ-b
description: 把不显著差异作 ties 后，direct/TBT 平均 τ-b 仍支持 TBT 提高 agreement。

name: Gemma BPB 负面诊断
description: 四个 Gemma 从主 perplexity 分析排除；Table 3/B.2 将 Wiki/Stack 异常追溯到 BOS 与 rolling-window。

name: component deletion / PEFT sensitivity
description: 未报告删除 train-before-test 组件、LoRA rank/dropout、learning-rate sensitivity 或 alternative fine-tuning method 的专门消融。

name: seed-level replication
description: 未报告随机种子、重复运行或 seed-level aggregation，因此不能把 pair-level 稳定性解释为跨 seed 复现。

name: Stage 1 pre-training removal
description: 去掉 IDDQN warm start 后 Figure 3 后期 reward 下降、波动大；Table 4 reward 10665.02，作者将其归因于样本不足并写作 fails to converge。

name: QK positive normalization removal
description: 去掉 normalization 后 reward 10839.33，低于其他方法且波动大；作者将原因归于 parameter redundancy。

name: Noise type
description: BSC、Uniform、Gaussian 三种 noise 都超过 conventional MARL；BSC 最差但用于主比较，最优 noise 仍待探索。

name: Positional embedding
description: 去 PE 检验 permutation invariance 与长度外推；w/ PE 在 3,910/4,264 orders 为 ×，且测试场景不再超过 prior MARL SOTA。

name: ARL-based versus vanilla MLP encoder
description: Triple-BERT reward 从 vanilla MLP 的 14967 增到 ARL-based 的 15388；DeepPool/BMG-Q 也提升，HIVES/Enders/CEVD 基本不提升。

name: Centralization/decomposition component isolation
description: 没有直接去掉 centralized execution、ILP/action decomposition、BERT/QK、Critic-BERT 或 reward component 的完整 removal/swap 实验。

name: additional_view_decoder
description: 在 RENDER 增加一个 context view，transfer AUC@20° 为 33.1/25.1/22.3/14.9，probe 为 48.0/47.4/64.2/42.6；检验 decoder 侧 context 的 interpolation 影响。

name: additional_view_encoder_decoder
description: POSE_ENC 与 RENDER 都看到 additional context，transfer AUC@20° 为 7.2/6.3/1.2/3.2，显示完整 multi-view end-to-end 会破坏 transfer。

name: unconstrained_autoencoding
description: 保持 stereo-monocular 但改回 standard autoencoding；transfer AUC@20° 为 36.8/39.4/47.0/14.0，低于 XFactor。

name: latent_bottleneck
description: 将 pose latent 降为 16 dimensions；transfer AUC@20° 为 40.6/41.4/50.8/15.8，probe 为 47.2/51.9/71.0/48.6；transfer 接近 XFactor，但描述能力可能受限。

name: se3_plucker
description: 预测 SE(3)、camera intrinsics 并使用 Plücker embeddings；transfer AUC@20° 为 35.7/26.4/28.4/12.6，低于 XFactor 与 unconstrained baseline。

name: simclr_vicreg
description: 不用 RENDER，分别以 SimCLR/InfoNCE (τ=0.1) 和 VICReg 训练 POSE_ENC；两者 probe AUC 远低于 XFactor。
evidence_sections: Appendix B Comparison Against Self-Supervised Learning Objectives

name: temporal_shift_corruption
description: 以 temporal shift +1 或 +2 替换部分正确 augmentation pair；transfer 相对稳定，probe 下降更明显。
evidence_sections: Appendix B Robustness of Transferability Objective

name: CFG removal
description: 删除 CFG 后 UALM-Gen-Base 的 SongDescriber CL 为 .39 vs Base .45，AudioCaps .25 vs .51；FD/KL/AES 也整体变差。

name: DPO addition
description: 加入 DPO 后 UALM-Gen 的 CL/AES 从 SongDescriber .45/6.70 到 .51/7.36，AudioCaps .51/4.47 到 .57/4.99；FD 不单调改善。

name: Enhancement VAE addition
description: 加入后端后 UALM-Gen FD 从 217.90/186.01 降至 74.43/75.14（SongDescriber/AudioCaps），并改善多项指标。

name: data scale down-weighting
description: 30M 数据降到 1/2、1/4、1/8、1/16、1/32；1/32 出现 overfitting，支持大数据是 LM 生成瓶颈。

name: synthetic-data adaptation
description: DPO 前删除 winning synthetic samples 的 CE adaptation 会造成 DPO loss 早期 spike。

name: winning-sample CE regularizer
description: DPO 中删除 winning-sample CE 后 divergence 从 reference 快速变负；加入 CE 让其接近 0。

name: component deletion
description: Table 3 删除 Virtual、Guide、两者，并以 Vanilla InfoNCE 替代整个 objective；覆盖 clean 与 MR=.2/CR=.2、Scene15 与 UMPC-Food101。

name: virtual-sample boundary
description: 作者称 clean datasets 上 Virtual Sample 效果不显著，较小 ρ 可能更好。

name: GMM-guide mechanism
description: 作者称 GMM-guided marginal estimation consistently enhances clustering accuracy；Table 3 给出删除版本。

name: hyperparameter sensitivity
description: Figure 5/6 分别扫描 ρ×m 和 ρ×t；m 过大导致 overly smoothed distribution，t 增大是 modest gain。

name: noise-range robustness
description: Figure 4 在 CR 0–.8 且 MR=.2/.5 时比较四方法的性能曲线。

name: compute-cost ablation
description: 没有报告 Sinkhorn iteration、GMM 或 virtual sample 的 wall-clock、memory、throughput 或 computational-complexity 对照。

name: qualitative noise cases
description: Figure 8 给出 UMPC-Food101 noisy image-text pair；不是方法失败案例，而是数据噪声动机案例。

name: Reasoning paradigm
description: Pattern-aware reasoning improves OOD relative to flexible reasoning, especially CF +6.2 and CD +3.3 percentage points.

name: Training-stage composition
description: MiPO and P-GRPO each help over SFT; applying MiPO before P-GRPO is reported best.

name: Cold-start necessity
description: Pure RL without cold-start has lower overall performance despite some ID/CM differences.

name: Pattern-aware reward
description: Pattern-aware reward beats vanilla accuracy reward on CF/CD; reflection reward helps both GRPO variants.

name: Individual patterns
description: Reflection removal is most damaging on CF/CD; planning is more useful on CM; conclusion supplies smaller gains.

name: MiPO correct-vague traces
description: Removing s_l^phi lowers CF/CD from 90.3/82.2 to 89.2/81.4; Figure 20 shows shallower reasoning.
evidence_sections: §5.3 Ablations on the non-preference in MiPO|Figure 20

name: MiPO incorrect traces
description: Removing s_l^psi collapses all splits to 65.3/64.8/58.6/54.3.

name: P-GRPO data selection
description: Balanced sampling is strongest among in-domain choices; partially unseen AIGIBench raises CF by 3.8 points with lower ID.
evidence_sections: Table 19|Appendix A.5.4 Effect of Training Data in P-GRPO Stage

name: Hyperparameters
description: Lower beta-prime and G=4 outperform stronger KL or larger groups in the reported settings.

name: Reward-model scale
description: Qwen2.5-VL-3B and UnifiedReward-Qwen-3B distinguish reflection quality better than SophiaVL-R1-3B; 7B does not materially improve.
evidence_sections: Appendix A.5.6 Effect of Different Reward Model

name: Robustness and efficiency
description: Compression/blur and resolution-stratified latency are supplementary checks, not mechanism-isolating ablations.

name: Acoustic-only versus Hybrid tokenizer
description: Table 2 compares overall WER-W 6.22/.68 SIM-O versus 1.84/.64; identifies semantic guidance/content stability versus speaker timbre trade-off.

name: model scale 1.5B versus 7B
description: Table 1/2 compare subjective average, WER-W and SIM-O; scale is not separated from compute or curriculum differences.

name: masked_input_robustness

name: intermediate_image_quality

description: PUG intervention 的三类 heads 分别展示 top-K 与 intervention magnitude 的曲线，正文取最佳参数。

name: Relative versus absolute position patching
description: 用同一 absolute position 与同一 relative position 的 missing target 做 mechanism alternative test。

description: RSA 跨 Qwen、LLaVA、Idefics2 与多个 scale；CMA heatmaps 跨六组 core models。

name: 独立三阶段组件 deletion
description: 未报告分别删除 ID retrieval、ID selection、feature retrieval 后的单独行为表；已有 activation patching 与 aggregate head ablation。

name: input encoder: pretraining and adaptation
description: baseline DAv2-S+Res18/DPT-S 为 Sintel 1.18/2.33、Spring 0.27/1.43；Res18 updater=1.27/2.81、0.27/1.59；只用 DAv2-S=1.55/2.64、0.37/2.70；去预训练=1.42/2.74、0.28/1.77（各为 Clean/Final 与 EPE/1px）。

description: ConvGRU 为 Sintel 2.79/4.80、Spring 0.39/2.71，较 DPT baseline 明显差；作者将其解释为 long-range dependence。

name: high-resolution indexing
description: 1/8 warp：Sintel 1.15/2.31、Spring 0.32/1.82；1/8 corr：1.10/2.45、0.33/1.74；Spring 1px 相对 baseline 改善，但各 EPE 方向不完全一致。

name: warping vs cost-volume at 1/8

name: feature-space vs image-space warp
description: image-space warp：Sintel 1.28/2.50、Spring 0.27/1.37、1902G；feature-space baseline 858G，作者称稍好且无需每轮重提特征。

name: removing warp
description: Refine w/o warp：Sintel 2.04/3.42、Spring 0.58/9.44、858G；作者称 warp 降误差而代价 negligible。

name: context encoder
description: w/ Context：Sintel 1.22/2.32、Spring 0.29/1.70、1005G；相对 baseline 无明显收益且增加计算。

name: rubric_dimension_variants
description: Agentic evaluator separately uses intention、static、dynamic、combined rubrics to identify dimension and combination effects; combined average is 60.55%.

name: guidance_protocol

name: observation_modality
description: Image Only、Code Only、Both isolate visual and source-code evidence; Both is usually best in pairwise.

name: position_swap_debias
description: Appendix E.1 evaluates each pair twice after swapping positions; overall gains are small or negative for listed models.

name: non_tie_sensitivity

name: agent_integrated_ensemble
description: Adding UI-TARS-1.5 to static LLM results tests precision–recall complementarity; GPT-4.1 and DeepSeek each gain 1.2–1.3 points.

name: component_deletion_ablation
description: 没有 planner、executor、summarizer 或 rubric tree 的同条件删除矩阵；作者说明未专门优化整体 framework structure。

name: SAE_vs_embed_topdims_pca
description: A.2 replaces SAE by variance-selected embedding dimensions or top PCA components, holds M=32 and interpretation/fidelity scoring fixed. Mean fidelity/high-fidelity/non-redundant values are 0.33/19.6/18.0 for SAE, 0.20/12.7/10.7 for Embed-TopDims, and 0.13/4.9/4.6 for Embed-PCA.

name: M_scale_sweep
description: A sweep M∈{16,32,64,128} lowers the non-redundant high-fidelity fraction from 39.3% at M=32 to 29.2% at M=128 without AUC improvement; CA non-redundant feature count rises 24→72, exposing coverage–interpretability trade-off.

name: prompt_conditioning
description: Average AUC for response-only, prompt+response, and interaction-augmented embeddings is 0.717/0.722/0.726; HH-RLHF improves 0.647→0.674 with interactions, so simple prompt encoding is weak on average but conditional methods remain open.

name: reward_model_size
description: On CA, best Llama-3.1-8B reward model held-out accuracy is 68.7% versus 68.6% for best Llama-3.2-3B; the paper keeps 3B for the main comparison.

name: embedding_and_seed_robustness
description: ModernBERT versus OpenAI embedding and two independent HH-RLHF SAE seeds produce qualitatively matched feature descriptions; this checks representation/reproducibility, not a quantitative downstream effect.

name: mechanism_alternative_checks
description: Table 10 inspects prompt irrelevance behind CA sustainability dispreference, and the Arena effect persists after filtering 8.8% explicit-refusal rows, addressing two plausible alternative explanations without randomized counterfactual prompts.

name: tiling_disablement
description: Setting block size equal to sequence length still fails, ruling out tiling as the direct cause.

name: layer2_flash_attention
description: FA only in layer 2 is sufficient for failure; standard attention in layer 2 restores stability.

name: delta_formula_substitution
description: The mathematically equivalent dP/P formulation of δ stabilizes training.

name: output_precision_substitution
description: FP32 recomputation of PV in backward or O in forward stabilizes while other operations remain BF16.

name: head_precision_substitution
description: Computing O in FP32 for heads 1, 7, 8, 9, 11 and 12 restores stability; head 8 is then analyzed.

name: pv_only_fp32
description: FP32 only for the unnormalized P̄V product is sufficient to stabilize.

name: dynamic_maximum_conditions
description: Appendix C rejects fixed offset, restricts adjustment to repeated maxima, and selects m=0 for negative repeated maxima; β is stated in [2,8] and set to 2 in Fig. 7.

name: optimizer_and_model_extension
description: The intervention is shown with AdamW, Muon and the larger GPT-2M, but only as curves.

name: negative_cases_and_cost
description: No reported mitigation failure case, runtime/memory overhead, or comprehensive alternative-source stress test.

name: controllability_vs_visual_quality
description: Figure 5 compares AR SR against generation quality and 1−LPIPS controllability; text describes the latter relation as clearer.

name: post_training_data_size
description: 400/4K/40K/80K post-training instances for Wan2.2†, Wan2.1†, SVD† in AR; each model trains one epoch.

name: inference_time_scaling
description: Varies average WM inferences per AR episode and reports a positive SR relation.

name: input_context
description: Front-view/panorama post-training input comparison across AR and ImageNav; results are mixed.

name: revision_policy
description: Compares VLM-based and LPIPS-based revision on ImageNav.

name: domain_transfer
description: Post-trains on HSSD vs HM3D and evaluates HM3D/MP3D AR/ImageNav suites.

name: alternative_VLM_base
description: Appendix Table 7 switches Qwen revision/base model to InternVL3 for AR/ImageNav/A-EQA.

name: No Synth. Tokenizer：tokenizer 替代

name: Llama-3.2-3B backbone：同规模替代
description: Llama Avg. Improv. 2.82% vs Qwen 15.0%；训练 loss 更低但 validation loss 更高（3.702 vs 3.620），作者据此记录 overfitting。

name: HierVAE：有利 baseline 条件

name: DGAE VQ vs chemically grounded blocks：机制替代
description: QM9 validity 均 100%；DGAE synthesizability 62% vs mCLM 100%，SA 4.46 vs 2.23；支持 codebook 与 synthesis-verified blocks 的差异。

name: 计算成本
description: Allchemy 每 molecule 30 分钟、supercomputing cluster；mCLM 训练 4×A100 80GB；未给总 wall-clock 或 monetary cost。

description: 主测试仅 122 个 synthesis-guaranteed FDA structures；案例取消 synthesis restriction；多目标 trade-off 未解决。

name: system_prompt_hint
description: Behavioral intervention: tell GPT-4o that the user may initially omit needed information.

name: temperature
description: Randomness sensitivity: vary assistant and user temperature over 0, 0.5, and 1.

name: episodic_translation_negative_result

name: qualitative_mechanism_analyses
description: Four observational analyses target premature answering, answer bloat, turn-position attention, and verbosity.

description: Figure 4 covers five extensive-form games, though it gives no effect-size summary across games.

description: Strength sweeps and most normal-form diagnostics reside in Appendix A rather than the main manuscript.

name: calibration ratio γ
description: γ=0.8 is best; γ=1.0 drops to 55.02 and 55.98, supporting a hard stage.

name: sharpness s0
description: s0=30 is best on Qwen3-4B and Llama2-7B; excessive values reduce Avg.

name: α and Δ strategies
description: LM beats static approximation and direct learning, with Avg 57.06 and 57.69.

name: µ in reconstruction
description: Without µ slightly exceeds with µ while retaining hardware-friendly W≈αT.

name: learnable threshold
description: Learnable Δ exceeds fixed threshold choices on both ablated models.

name: calibration sample count
description: Avg improves through 512 and 1024 samples; 512 is chosen as a cost-accuracy compromise.

name: group size
description: Smaller groups generally perform better; group size 128 is the default for comparison fairness.

name: ST loss curves
description: Figure B shows lower final loss with ST across six sliding windows.

name: complex-task pilot
description: Direct CAT-Q has severe math/code degradation; CAT-Q+ changes calibration data generation.

description: Table 2 adds M1 Stage-I focal weighting, M2 context distillation, M3 context-aware adaptation, and M4 context consistency; PSNR rises 21.62 to 26.80.

description: M1 improves PSNR but VFID changes 34.74 to 38.21 and DISTS 0.088 to 0.091; nearby prose emphasizes cumulative PSNR gains without explaining this reversal.

description: Table 3 比较双 bias-aware sDISCO、单 bias-aware sDISCO 与 ResNet；作者将后者解释为 simulated unobserved confounder setting。这是机制诊断，不是内部组件删除。

description: Figure 1/12/13 examine attention patterns, but do not supply an intervention that distinguishes all kernel-like explanations.
